sentences.en: Please push this button at once in case of emergency.
sentences.zh: 如果发生紧急情况，请立即按下这个按钮。

sentences.en: All you have to do is to push this button.
sentences.zh: 你所需要做的就是按一下这个按钮。

sentences.en: She pushed the panic button when she heard the news.
sentences.zh: 她听到消息后按下了恐慌按钮。

phrases.zh: 穿孔（穿在肚脐或其它部位的）

senses.zh: 扣住；装有纽扣；扣上纽扣
